question: What is discussed about Observium: An auto-discovering network monitoring platform?
answer: This is a great free tool, just don't ask for something the developer doesn't agree with. He and the IRC community supporting it will tear you to shreds. Also check ntop out -- it has similar traffic reports, but no such fancy multibox support last time I looked.That's more a job for SNMP clients anyway. Actually, just look at Nagios/Icinga :) It's a very mature and well-rooted infrastructure monitoring solution. Another system focused on the wrong thing in monitoring: on alerts and charts.
